hero.subtitle: Archive of life forms
hero.body: Explore nature from a new perspective with the virtual collection of biophysical data from CICIMA, where insects and other organisms inspire scientific and technological advances based on the richness of local biodiversity

contact.title: Would you like to collaborate on the research? Let's talk!

cicima.title: CICIMA
cicima.body: A multi- and interdisciplinary scientific and technological research unit devoted to the study of the physical and chemical properties of materials, for their development and adaptation in industrial processes.
